distanceSource: Inverse of the parallax 747.17 ± 0.61 mas that Kervella et al. (2017) adopt from Kervella et al. (2016)
radiusSource: Radius: Limb-darkened angular diameter 5.999 ± 0.025 mas measured with VLTI/PIONIER by Kervella et al. (2017), A&A 597, A137, who derive 0.8632 ± 0.0037 solar radii with the parallax 747.17 ± 0.61 mas. Adopted 600,528 km, 0.8632 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius.
